meta.name: follow-up
meta.description: Writes follow-up emails for B2B cold email sequences. Use when the user asks to "write a follow-up", "email 2", "email 3", "sequence email", "they didn't reply", "no response", "bump email", "breakup email", or needs help structuring a 3-email sequence. Also triggers on "follow-up sequence", "second email", "third email", "what to send after no reply". Do NOT use for first-touch emails, re-engagement of old/lost leads, or deliverability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出 B2B 冷邮件跟进序列，提升回复率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做B2B邮件营销，需要自动生成跟进邮件
copy.tagline_en: Write B2B cold email follow-ups to boost reply rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do B2B email marketing and need automatic follow-up emails

howto.what: 当你要写B2B冷邮件的后续时，Claude会基于第一封邮件调整角度，生成第二或第三封跟进邮件，并提醒你获取新触发信号来避免重复。
howto.when: 当你要求写后续邮件、提到“没有回复”或“第二封邮件”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一封冷邮件跟进，对方没回复。
say.note: Claude会要求提供第一封邮件内容，然后生成第二封。

say.text: 写第三封分手邮件，语气要柔和。
say.note: Claude会采用降低门槛的策略。

say.text: 我第一封说的是节省成本，第二封换个角度。

howto.what_en: When you need to write B2B cold email follow-ups, Claude will adjust the angle from Email 1, draft Email 2 or Email 3, and remind you to get fresh signals to avoid repetition.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to 'write a follow-up', mention 'no response', 'email 2', or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Write a follow-up cold email, they didn't reply.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the first email and generate the second.

say_en.text: Draft a breakup email for Email 3, soft tone.
say_en.note: Claude will lower the friction strategy.

say_en.text: Email 1 was about saving cost; rotate to a different angle.
say_en.note: Claude will apply value prop rotation.
